name: combobox
title: Combo box
description: Type to filter a long list and pick one or several items, with load-more and app-side results.

when: Picking from a long list (customers, products, countries) by typing.

instead.when: People search across actions and records with ⌘K, not fill a field.

builtIn: Announces the result count and "No results".
Required fields show "Fill in this field." after a blur or a submit; your own `errorMessage` replaces it.

genui.description: A searchable list to pick from by typing. items are {id, label, secondary?}. Emits change.
